summary: Map capabilities, redesign roles and plan reskilling for AI-driven work. Explore the practical course outline and see if it fits your team.
lede: Skills-based workforce planning and role redesign connect business priorities with the capabilities and roles needed as AI and automation change work. For HR leaders, workforce planners and transformation teams, this involves analyzing tasks, mapping skills and defining redesigned roles and reskilling pathways. You will also assess human-AI task allocation and oversight, identify skill gaps, and create a workforce roadmap with measures leaders can review.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who shape workforce capabilities, role structures or reskilling decisions as AI and automation change how work gets done.
outcomes: AI Role Redesign and Task Analysis
